---
title: "Weekly treatment — data and descriptive summaries"
format: html
---

- Treated week: any day between the first and last administration of a line; untreated weeks are observed, not missing.
- Follow-up is unrestricted (to death, last known alive or the data lock), as exported; no 182-day cap.
- State occupancy plots (untreated, treated, dead), weeks 1-26: the death week is dead (as in TAOOH) and death is carried forward to week 26; censored patients leave the denominator.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(mostr)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

horizon_weeks <- as.integer(config$analysis$horizon_days / 7)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "11-weekly-treatment", "results")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)
therapy_weekly <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-therapy-weekly.parquet")
) |>
  left_join(
    cohort |> select(id, tx, survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted),
    by = "id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )
```

## Analysis data

```{r}
#| label: treatment-data

treatment_data <- therapy_weekly |>
  summarise(
    weeks_treated = sum(treated),
    exposure_weeks = n(),
    first_treated_week = if (any(treated == 1L)) min(week[treated == 1L]) else NA_integer_,
    .by = id
  ) |>
  right_join(cohort, by = "id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    ecog_group = case_when(
      ecog_fstcnt >= 3 ~ "3+",
      .default = as.character(ecog_fstcnt)
    ),
    ecog_group = factor(
      ecog_group,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    weeks_treated,
    exposure_weeks,
    first_treated_week,
    days_treated,
    ever_treated,
    n_treatment_lines,
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    age,
    ecog_group
  )

n_zero_exposure <- sum(is.na(treatment_data$exposure_weeks))

# Zero follow-up means no time at risk, so no rate: excluded.
treatment_data <- treatment_data |>
  filter(!is.na(exposure_weeks))

stopifnot(
  all(treatment_data$exposure_weeks ==
        ceiling(treatment_data$survival_time_days_unrestricted / 7)),
  all((treatment_data$weeks_treated > 0) == (treatment_data$ever_treated == 1L))
)

write_parquet(
  treatment_data,
  file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

n_zero_exposure
```

## Descriptive summary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-treatment-descriptive
#| tbl-cap: "Treatment over unrestricted follow-up by randomized group"

descriptive_summary <- treatment_data |>
  mutate(group = group_factor(tx)) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    ever_treated = sum(ever_treated),
    with_second_line = sum(n_treatment_lines >= 2),
    follow_up_weeks = sum(exposure_weeks),
    treated_weeks = sum(weeks_treated),
    proportion_weeks_treated = treated_weeks / follow_up_weeks,
    proportion_days_treated = sum(days_treated) / sum(survival_time_days_unrestricted),
    first_treated_week_median = median(first_treated_week, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_treated_week_q1 = quantile(first_treated_week, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_treated_week_q3 = quantile(first_treated_week, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  arrange(group)

write_parquet(
  descriptive_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "descriptive-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

kable(descriptive_summary, digits = 3)
```

## State occupancy, weeks 1-26

```{r}
#| label: state-occupancy-data

state_labels <- c("Untreated", "Treated", "Dead")

# construct three state outcome (no ordinal ranking)
alive_weeks <- therapy_weekly |>
  filter(week <= horizon_weeks) |>
  mutate(
    death_week = status_death_unrestricted == 1L &
      week == ceiling(survival_time_days_unrestricted / 7),
    state = if_else(death_week, 3L, treated + 1L)
  )

# carry forward
dead_weeks <- alive_weeks |>
  filter(death_week, week < horizon_weeks) |>
  reframe(week = seq.int(week + 1L, horizon_weeks), state = 3L, .by = c(id, tx))

state_data <- bind_rows(
  alive_weeks |> select(id, tx, week, state),
  dead_weeks
) |>
  mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = 1:3, labels = state_labels),
    tx = group_factor(tx)
  )

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(state_data[c("id", "week")]))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-treatment-state-occupancy
#| fig-cap: "Observed proportion of patients untreated, treated or dead in each week after random selection. Death is carried forward; censored patients leave the denominator."
#| fig-alt: "Line plot over weeks 1 to 26 of the observed proportions of untreated, treated and dead patients, with solid lines for ctDNA and dashed lines for usual care. Fewer ctDNA patients are treated in the first weeks."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

state_line_plot <- plot_sops(
  state_data,
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "state",
  facet_var = NULL,
  linetype_var = "tx"
) +
  scale_colour_state() +
  scale_fill_state() +
  scale_linetype_group() +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "Proportion of patients",
    colour = "State",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  state_line_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "state-occupancy-lines.png"),
  height = 5
)

state_line_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-treatment-state-occupancy-bars
#| fig-cap: "Observed proportion of patients untreated, treated or dead in each week after random selection, by randomized group."
#| fig-alt: "Stacked bar chart with one bar per week from 1 to 26 and one panel per randomized group, showing the proportions of untreated, treated and dead patients."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

state_bar_plot <- plot_sops(
  state_data,
  time_var = "week",
  y_var = "state",
  facet_var = "tx",
  geom = "bar"
) +
  scale_colour_state() +
  scale_fill_state() +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "Proportion of patients",
    fill = "State",
    title = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  state_bar_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "state-occupancy-bars.png"),
  height = 5
)

state_bar_plot
```

## Proportion treated among patients alive, full follow-up

- Shown up to week 104 (about 10 patients per group left); no death state, so censoring does not bias the denominator.

```{r}
#| label: treated-among-alive

# rows after death are missing --> therefore among alive
# but I'm not sure sure what this plots actually shows, difficult selecton mechanism might be going on
treated_among_alive <- therapy_weekly |>
  filter(week <= 104L) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    treated = sum(treated),
    .by = c(tx, week)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = treated / patients,
    # Jeffreys interval.
    lower_95 = qbeta(0.025, treated + 0.5, patients - treated + 0.5),
    upper_95 = qbeta(0.975, treated + 0.5, patients - treated + 0.5),
    group = group_factor(tx)
  )

write_parquet(
  treated_among_alive |> select(-group),
  file.path(results_dir, "treated-among-alive.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-treated-among-alive
#| fig-cap: "Proportion of patients alive and under follow-up who were treated in each week, with 95% Jeffreys intervals"
#| fig-alt: "Line plot over weeks 1 to 104 of the proportion of patients alive and under follow-up who were treated, one line with a shaded interval per randomized group."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

treated_plot <- ggplot(
  treated_among_alive,
  aes(week, proportion, colour = group, fill = group)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_group() +
  scale_fill_group() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 104, by = 13)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "Treated among patients alive",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  treated_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "treated-among-alive.png"),
  height = 5
)

treated_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-treated-among-alive
#| tbl-cap: "Patients alive and under follow-up and proportion treated at selected weeks"

treated_among_alive |>
  filter(week %in% c(1, 2, 4, 8, 13, 26, 52, 78, 104)) |>
  select(group, week, patients, proportion) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(patients, proportion)) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
